title: Zoning map change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Long Island City
summary: This rezones a site at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens from an M1-4/R6B district to an R7X district with a C2-5 commercial overlay. The change would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 84 apartments, including 21 income-restricted units, and ground-floor retail. A related text amendment would designate the site as a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.
